agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: At Breloom 13 HP the scorer initially preferred a zero-progress critical-safety switch over the bounded priority Vacuum Wave finish.

resolution.observed: The corrected live Vacuum Wave KOed Breloom before any reply.

findings.observed_fact: The unchanged-state recommendation changed from emergency_critical_entry_switch to move 410 after the shared scorer fix.
findings.strategic_judgment: A switch guaranteed an enemy turn while Vacuum Wave had an average KO roll and Croakatoa survived every preempting critical plus the expected reply.
findings.next_test: Retain the exact priority-finisher regression and require the classifier, not an operator override, to choose move 410.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state was intentionally held but its rolling savestate was superseded after the corrected action; the exact stats are retained in the regression and transaction.

findings.summary: Triple Axel was modeled as one hit and its two-PP cartridge implementation was rejected, underbounding Bushtank damage by 8 HP.

resolution.observed: Disposable replay modeled 8-48 normal / 96 critical, attributed move 741 with delta 2, and verified cleanly.

findings.observed_fact: Three hits dealt 42 while the old critical ceiling was 34; move 741 consumed two PP.
findings.strategic_judgment: An underbounded multi-hit threat can select unsafe entries and invalidate survival certificates.
findings.next_test: Replay state 18304d50 and require the full three-hit envelope, move attribution, accepted PP delta, and no discrepancy.

findings.summary: Planning called map-local trainer 2 Hitoshi, while the authoritative intro identified Black Belt Takao.

resolution.observed: The additive trainer database now validates with a map-linked Takao record and all three authoritative live builds.

findings.observed_fact: RAM battle text named Takao and the live roster was Breloom, Buneary, Mienfoo.
findings.strategic_judgment: A wrong overworld identity can attach the wrong preparation record on a future run.
findings.next_test: Resolve map:3:3/local:2 by graphics 44 and script 0x08232280 to Takao and this exact roster.

findings.summary: The win left four party members materially damaged: Croakatoa 7/54, Lildozer 36/69, OhmNomNom 23/59, and Bushtank 17/69.
findings.observed_fact: Authoritative terminal party HP confirms the damage.
findings.strategic_judgment: Starting another trainer or Brawly without healing would convert a clean win into avoidable run risk.
findings.next_test: Heal and verify full HP/status/PP before any trainer contact.

findings.summary: Two consecutive Detect successes consumed 2 Sludge PP without progress.
findings.observed_fact: Both attacks were protected and no HP changed.
findings.strategic_judgment: No legal move bypassed Detect and switching would donate tempo, so repeating the guaranteed-KO attack remained correct; chain probability is still unmodeled.
findings.next_test: Record Detect-chain history only if a future matchup offers a materially different action.

correct_choices: Opening Croakatoa Fake Out gave verified free chip and activated Breloom Toxic Orb without exposure.
The corrected priority Vacuum Wave finished Breloom instead of donating a switch turn.
Bushtank safely absorbed fresh Buneary Fake Out; OhmNomNom then used Iron Barbs plus fresh Fake Out to finish.
Lildozer Charm cut Mienfoo physical damage by two stages before the planned Croakatoa pivot.
The controller persisted with guaranteed-KO Sludge through two Detects instead of switch cycling.
agent_review.next_test: Heal the whole party, verify Takao review and trainer record gates, then reach Brawly precontact without engaging and begin the mandatory hard-fight preparation plus three reviewed clones.
